notes.content:

notes.title: 🎉 Find 100 Ducks and Blast Them! is OUT NOW 🦆
notes.content:
The ultimate duck-hunting challenge has arrived! Can you find and shoot all 100 hidden ducks? Use your skills, radar, and speed to complete the hunt while uncovering secrets along the way.

🔫 Play now!

Relax, take aim, and let the feathers fly ! 🪶
